caption_fb:
Some Polish church books are older than the United States.

One major online collection of Polish church books starts in 1568, more than 200 years before 1776.

Not every parish kept books that early, and wars destroyed many. But depending on the parish, your family may be traceable much further back than you think.

Centuries of family records still wait in parish offices and archives across rural Poland.
